description: asn.fr: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by asn.fr. Coverage: the area served by asn.fr. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Territoire à Risque d'Inondation (TRI) de Noirmoutier - Saint-Jean-de-; Territoires à Risques Important d'Inondation (TRI) de Angers - val d’A; Territoires à Risque d'Inondation (TRI) de Saint-Nazaire - Guérande - ; Territoires à Risques Important d'Inondation (TRI) du Mans - Carte de . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
